about: Phase 8 scope audit (docs/phases/PHASE-8.md). Every valid event, destroyed, goal, knows and fulfilled assertion in the recorded real-model runs, with the other people its value involves. Participants were identified by reading each distinct value (manual review by the implementing agent, 2026-09-24; not the owner). Synthetic Korean scenes, test data only. Check: python3 tools/check_phase8_scope_audit.py Since the Phase 8 real-model tier, the extract-v8 runs of the Phase 8 scenes are listed too, each with the model's own `with` (model_participants) and whether the manual review agrees.

rules.participant: a character or group other than the subject and object that the value is about: acted on, received, accompanied, addressed, or whose possession the value is about (kind possessor); kind implied: involved in the value's action and named in the TARGET turn, though not in the value (Phase 8 runs only)
rules.usable: Phase 8 predicate (event, destroyed, goal, knows), route fact or claim, and at least one participant other than the persona
